duration.text: The Mechanical Design and Theory at Tongji University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5694 USD/per year ￥ 41000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 7. Study plan Research or study plan in China 8. Copy of article or papers published Catalogue and abstract of published paper, and other documents that can prove academic ability, and special documents required by the target college.
